messages:
zara: Noticed a parsing hang in the onboarding sample when EventSource resumes after a network flap. Final JSON tails sometimes duplicate or go missing. Short repro below.

ev an: browser or node?

zara: Both. Start a stream with a logical JSON split across chunks, kill net mid-chunk, reconnect with Last-Event-ID. Client occasionally gets a split tail re-emitted as a separate fragment so assembly produces duplicated text or invalid JSON.

ryan: That sounds like resume token is being advanced at fragment emission rather than at logical-message completion. Any console snippets?

zara: Example:
received id=7 chunk="{\"text\":\"Hel"
received id=8 chunk="{\"text\":\"lo Wo"
// drop
reconnect Last-Event-ID=8
received id=8 chunk="rld"
received id=9 chunk="{\"text\":\"Bye\"}
Result: either 8+8' or 8' merged into 9 -> broken JSON.

evan: Quick mitigation: sample-app add dedupe by hashing last fragment per event-id on resume. Note in README. Long-term: runtime should only advance resume token on complete logical messages or emit boundary sentinel.

ci-bot: CI queued: sample-app/stream-fix (job 4521).

zara: Pushed small patch with dedupe helper and a headless flap test behind an env flag. Filed TKT-4120 for a runtime fix and linked traces.

ryan: LGTM. Make the helper very visible in README so users don't copy it wholesale into prod.

zara: Will do. Marking for follow-up when runtime ETA is available. :thumbsup:
